comparisonFormatting: The retained comparison uses four-space indentation; parsed values exactly match the original artifact comparison.
sourceProvenanceScope: The complete original summary source object is stored once per source arm. Exact deep equality was checked across all 28 baseline summaries (A and C) and all 14 candidate summaries (B), including warmups.

validationScope.deduplication: Every run validation object from all 42 warmup and timed summaries was checked for exact deep equality with sharedValidation. Each retained run explicitly refers to that object.
validationScope.coverage: Sampled browser persistence checks, including 12 content probes and post-restart checks; not exhaustive persisted-data equality.
validationScope.mediaProbeLimitation: No media rows in the JMdict fixture.
